subject: ATR 72 - 起落架系統 (Landing Gear System)

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於 ATR 72 起落架系統的動力來源與控制邏輯,下列敘述何者正確?
zh_options: (A) 起落架的收放由 Blue System 提供液壓動力
(B) 起落架為液壓控制 (Hydraulically controlled) 且液壓驅動 (Hydraulically actuated)
(C) 起落架為電器控制 (Electrically controlled) 且由 Green System 液壓驅動
(D) 緊急放輪 (Emergency Extension) 必須依靠 Blue System 的蓄壓器壓力
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding the ATR 72 landing gear system power source and control logic, which of the following is correct?
en_options: (A) Retraction and extension are powered by the Blue hydraulic system
(B) The landing gear is hydraulically controlled and hydraulically actuated
(C) The landing gear is electrically controlled and hydraulically actuated by the Green system
(D) Emergency extension relies on Blue system accumulator pressure
mc_questions.explanation: ATR 起落架系統由 Green System 提供動力,但在控制面上是透過電器訊號傳遞給選向閥 (Selector Valve)。Normal operation requires electrical power for control and hydraulic pressure (Green system) for actuation.

mc_questions.zh_question: 在起落架控制面板上,當起落架手柄移至 UP 位,但紅色 UNLK 燈持續亮著,最可能的系統邏輯解釋為何?
zh_options: (A) 起落架已經完全收起並上鎖
(B) 起落架尚未到達選定位置或未在上鎖位置 (Not in the selected position / Not locked)
(C) 這是正常的過渡狀態,不論收多久都不會消失
(D) 代表綠色液壓系統壓力過高
mc_questions.en_question: On the L/G control panel, if the red UNLK lights remain illuminated after the L/G lever is moved to UP, what is the most likely system logic explanation?
en_options: (A) The landing gear is fully retracted and locked
(B) The landing gear is not in the selected position or not locked
(C) This is a normal transient state and will never disappear
(D) It indicates that the Green system pressure is too high
mc_questions.explanation: 起落架指示燈中,紅色 UNLK (Unlock) 燈亮表示起落架處於不安全狀態 (Unsafe condition),即起落架位置與手柄選取的 position 不一致,或是尚未完成 Locking 動作 (Up-locked or Down-locked)。

mc_questions.zh_question: 起落架手柄 (L/G selector lever) 的鎖定機構 (Lever Lock) 是為了防止在地面誤收起落架。此鎖定機構何時會自動解鎖?
zh_options: (A) 當飛機空速達到 V1 時
(C) 當兩側主起落架的 Shock Absorbers 皆伸展 (Weight-Off-Wheels) 時
(D) 當液壓系統壓力達到 3000 PSI 時
mc_questions.en_question: The L/G selector lever lock mechanism prevents accidental retraction on the ground. When does this lock automatically release?
en_options: (C) When both main gear shock absorbers are extended (Weight-Off-Wheels)
mc_questions.explanation: Lever Lock 受控於主起落架上的近接感應器 (Proximity Sensors)。當飛機起飛離地,避震支柱 (Shock Absorbers) 伸展,感應到 Weight-Off-Wheels 時,Solonoid 會動作讓 Lock 釋放,手柄才能移往 UP 位。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The maximum speed for landing gear retraction (VLO retract) is {{c1::160}} KIAS.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 起落架收起的速度上限 (VLO retract) 為 160 節。
cloze_items.explanation: 收輪時受風壓影響最大,故 VLO retract 通常低於 VLO extension。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The maximum speed with the landing gear extended (VLE) is {{c1::185}} KIAS.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 起落架伸展狀態下的最大允許速度 (VLE) 為 185 節。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是起落架完全放下並鎖定後的結構速限。

cloze_items.cloze_text: During emergency extension, the gear is extended using {{c1::gravity}} after releasing the hydraulic pressure.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在緊急放輪過程中,釋放液壓壓力後,起落架是利用重力下墜伸展的。
cloze_items.explanation: Free-fall extension 依靠組件自重與氣動力完成放輪與上鎖。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The Anti-skid system is deactivated when the aircraft speed drops below {{c1::10}} knots.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 當飛機速度降至 10 節以下時,防滑系統 (Anti-skid) 會停止作動。
cloze_items.explanation: 低速時為了維持煞車效率,系統會停用防滑邏輯以便完全煞停。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Landing gear operation and nose wheel steering are powered by the {{c1::Green}} hydraulic system.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 起落架操作與鼻輪轉向皆由綠色液壓系統供壓。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是 ATR 系統佈置的核心邏輯,Green 負責多數起落架相關組件。
